name: local-ai-orchestrator
description: Local-first Kanban orchestrator that delegates features to Claude Code agents in isolated git worktrees

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run dev -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run dist -w desktop
